fact: Windsor's 2026 lawn-replacement rebate pays $1 to $2 per square foot, up to $2,000 per water account, for front-yard lawn replaced with living plants, and artificial turf is not eligible.
quote: Artificial Turf is not eligible for this rebate. … Rebate includes $1-2 per square foot of living healthy turf removed, dependent upon project scope. … The maximum rebate amount is $2,000 per water account per year (front yard only). Living plant material of new design must account for 50% of the project area.
source_label: Town of Windsor, Lawn Replacement Program (2026)
notes: Submissions ran 2026-02-02 to 06-30; only projects completed in calendar 2026 qualify. Town water customers only.

fact: Johnstown's lawn-replacement rebate excludes artificial turf, caps payments at $2,000 per water account per year, and stopped taking new 2026 applications on June 15.
quote: Artificial Turf is not eligible for this rebate. … Maximum rebate amount is $2000 per water account per year. … As a result, new applications have closed on June 15.
source_label: Town of Johnstown, Lawn Replacement Resources
notes: $1–2 per sq ft; Town of Johnstown water accounts only. "June 15" has no year on the page; 2026 is inferred from the first-season context.

fact: Frederick's lawn-replacement rebate pays $2 per square foot up to $2,000 per water account per year for at least 200 square feet of lawn replaced, and artificial turf is not eligible.
quote: residents can receive a rebate of $2 per square foot—up to $2,000 per water account per year. … Artificial Turf is not eligible for this rebate. … Qualifying projects must replace at least 200 square feet.
source_label: Town of Frederick, Lawn Replacement Rebate Program
notes: Town of Frederick water accounts only (east of I-25). 2026 submissions closed Sept 1.

fact: Fort Collins Utilities' Xeriscape Incentive Program pays homeowners $0.75 per square foot, up to $750, for renovations that reach 50% plant coverage at maturity, and the program page does not list artificial turf as eligible.
quote: $0.75/square foot up to 1,000 square feet, or up to $750, per approved project, per address. … Requires 50% plant coverage at maturity in the renovation area.
source_label: Fort Collins Utilities, Xeriscape Incentive Program (XIP)
notes: Read via WebFetch (Akamai blocks curl). CORRECTED per layers digest: the native-plant bonus is an ADDITIONAL $0.25/sq ft (about $1/sq ft total) up to $1,000 total for at least 80% Colorado-native plants. The page names no artificial-turf rule either way; "turf-only projects cannot qualify" is INFERENCE from the 50% plant rule — phrase it that way or not at all.

fact: Resource Central's lawn-replacement program, offered through Fort Collins Utilities, Fort Collins-Loveland, Little Thompson and Left Hand water districts, Firestone and Longmont, requires at least 200 square feet replaced with at least 50% waterwise plants, and its 2026 program is full.
quote: Project areas must be at least 200 square feet and replaced with at least 50% waterwise plants.
source_label: Resource Central, Lawn Replacement program page
notes: resourcecentral.org returns 403 to curl; read via WebFetch 2026-09-24 ("The 2026 program is full" / applications closed; 2027 interest list open). Partner list read the same way included Town of Firestone, City of Longmont, Left Hand WD, Little Thompson WD, Fort Collins-Loveland WD and City of Fort Collins Utilities. Discounts come through each provider (LTWD and Firestone: up to $750).

fact: Resource Central's lawn-replacement program rules out projects that use artificial or synthetic turf.
quote: Your project is ineligible if… Replacement materials include use of artificial/synthetic turf
source_label: Resource Central, Lawn Replacement program page (Wayback snapshot 2026-08-03)
notes: DOWNGRADED to UNVERIFIED 2026-09-24 (legal review): the quote is NOT in its cited source. The Wayback capture 20260803160657 of resourcecentral.org/lawn/ (fetched with curl 2026-09-24, 398 KB) and the same capture's /lawn/faqs/ and /lawn/apply/ contain no 'artificial', 'synthetic' or 'ineligible'; the live page (WebFetch) names no artificial-turf rule and says only 'Project areas must be at least 200 square feet and replaced with at least 50% waterwise plants.' Every town page and guide now cites resource-central-lawn-2026 instead. Do not restore until a primary Resource Central page showing this exact wording is found and linked.

fact: Little Thompson Water District customers can get up to $750 off Resource Central lawn removal of at least 200 square feet, which brings the price to $1 per square foot for up to 454 square feet, but the 2026 program is closed.
quote: As an LTWD customer, you'll receive up to $750 off the labor cost, applied directly as a discount. The normal rate for lawn removal is $2.75 per square foot, but with your LTWD discount, you'll pay just $1 per square foot for up to 454 square feet of turf removed. … The 2026 program is closed for the season.
source_label: Little Thompson Water District, Lawn Replacement
notes: The program replaces lawn with gardens or low-water plantings; it is not an artificial-turf discount.

fact: Firestone residents can get a $750 discount on Resource Central lawn-removal services, but the program is full for 2026.
quote: Firestone residents can receive a $750 discount on lawn removal services. The Lawn Replacement Program is Full for 2026, and Applications have closed!
source_label: Town of Firestone, Lawn Replacement Program

fact: Greeley's 2026 residential water rebates cover high-efficiency toilets and irrigation equipment only, with no lawn-replacement or turf rebate listed.
quote: Greeley offers rebates for use of select high-efficiency toilets and irrigation systems.
source_label: City of Greeley, Residential Water Rebates
notes: Greeley's former "Life After Lawn" program is not on the page (a secondary source quotes staff saying it is no longer offered — not verified). When it ran, artificial turf was not eligible (old city page, not re-read).

fact: Evans' 2026 water-conservation programs are fixture replacement, $25 Garden in a Box kits and sprinkler evaluations, with no lawn-replacement or turf rebate listed.
quote: Garden in a Box $25 discounted garden kits for Evans residents!
source_label: City of Evans, Water Conservation Programs

fact: Wellington's water-efficiency program offers reduced-cost Garden In A Box kits and free irrigation audits, with no turf rebate listed.
quote: Garden in a Box (reduced cost for low water plants) Garden In A Box offers professionally designed, Waterwise, perennial garden kits tailor-made for Colorado yards.
source_label: Town of Wellington, Water Efficiency Program

fact: Loveland's own rebate pages could not be read on September 24, 2026, so its lawn-replacement terms are unconfirmed.
source_label: City of Loveland Utilities, Residential Rebates
notes: A secondary roundup (waterwiselandscapes.com, 2026-07-22) describes 50% discounted turf removal plus Garden In A Box kits. Parts of Loveland are FCLWD customers and fall under Resource Central through FCLWD.
